what_failed: tools/universe_screen.py calls the raw FMP REST API directly (urllib) and requires FMP_API_KEY as a local environment variable. This Cowork workspace deliberately holds NO local FMP secret (CONTEXT.md: 'market data and the book ride OAuth connectors (FMP/Tiger/IBKR/Drive), no local secret') -- the script predates the OAuth-connector migration and was never updated. Call failed HTTP 401 Unauthorized against financialmodelingprep.com/stable/company-screener.

Used the FULL 135-name daily_list as the nomination pool (broader net, closer in spirit to the D-3 daily open screen than the narrower longlist alone) in place of the standalone RB:universe.screen EMA/mcap/volume pass. This is real, dated, sourced data -- not fabricated -- but it is NOT the RB:universe.screen criteria verbatim, and no near_misses list (D-37 EMA/vol band) could be computed without the broken tool, so near_misses is empty this run rather than populated.
state_after: universe.json written from AQE daily_list (135 names, taxonomy-complete); near_misses empty (tool gap, not zero real near-misses); swarm proceeded on real data.
